title: My Hero Academia Releases 10th Anniversary Video Celebrating Deku's Journey With New Animation
content: My Hero Academia has released a special anniversary video as part of the anime’s ongoing 10th anniversary celebration, showing Izuku Midoriya’s journey from a Quirkless boy to the greatest hero through some of the series’ most memorable moments.
author: Anime Corner

title: A Yamaha X Botan Popup Event Is Coming to Shibuya
content: Yamaha is once again showing its love for kawaii anime girls. The company has announced a collaboration event with the Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk TV anime. The Yamaha x Botan popup event, named Horoyoi Sound Terrace, will take place at Yamaha Sound Crossing Shibuya from June 27 to August 16.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ghost in the Shell: The Ghost in the Shell Confirms Global Prime Video Streaming, Releases New Trailer
content: THE GHOST IN THE SHELL anime by Science SARU has confirmed its global streaming plans ahead of its July premiere, with Prime Video set to simulcast the anime in Japan and more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. Prime Video will begin streaming the episodes just 30 minutes after Japan at 11:30 p.m.
author: Anime Corner

title: Chainsaw Man: Reze Arc Movie Featured on First MAPPA 15th Anniversary Key Visual
content: MAPPA has revealed the first commemorative key visual for its upcoming 15th anniversary presentation, featuring Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc with a new illustration created exclusively for the event.
author: Anime Corner

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 11 (Part 1 Finale) Preview
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 11 (Episode 77 overall) preview ahead of its June 17, 2026 premiere. This will be the finale of Part 1.
author: Anime Corner

title: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand Anime's Video Reveals Theme Songs, July 3 Debut
content: The staff for the television anime of Ezogingitune and illustrator DeeCHA 's I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand ( Koko wa Ore ni Makasete Saki ni Ike to Ittekara 10-nen ga Tattara Densetsu ni Natteita. ) light novel series presented a new promotional video for the anime on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand Reveals Main PV, Theme Songs, July 6 Premiere
content: The upcoming I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand anime has released its main PV trailer and a July 6, 2026 premiere. The new trailer also debuts both the opening and ending themes for the first time. Studio GEKKOU is in charge of the animation, with Hiroyuki Kanbe as the director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis Anime Casts Kazuhiro Yamaji, Tōru Nara
content: The staff of Ishimori Production 's Cyborg 009: Nemesis , a new anime based on Shōtarō Ishinomori 's Cyborg 009 manga, revealed two new cast members on Tuesday. Yūki Kaji plays the anime's main character Joe Shimamura/Cyborg 009.
author: ANN
